'''Sebulba's Legacy''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course designed by the famed [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]], [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]. It was built on Sebulba's home planet, [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], sometime after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. This course was the second race in the [[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Podracing Circuit]] tournament.
